task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the 'Measurements' or 'Body weight and measurements' section of the wger application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser URL shows a path containing '/measurement/' and the page title or header indicates a measurement log.

task_completion.description: Agent selects the 'Waist' category from the list of measurement types.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the 'Waist' category being clicked or the 'Waist' specific measurement page loading.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies the most recent entry (initially 82.0 cm) and clicks the edit icon/button.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A cursor clicking an edit (pencil) icon next to the 82.0 entry, or a dropdown menu showing an 'Edit' option for that specific row.

task_completion.description: Agent clears the old value (82.0) and types the new value (79.5) into the measurement field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The measurement input field in the edit form contains the text '79.5'.

task_completion.description: Agent submits the form to save the updated measurement.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks a 'Save', 'Submit', or 'Update' button on the edit form.

task_completion.description: The measurement list now displays 79.5 cm for the most recent Waist entry.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final screenshot shows the Waist measurement table with the top entry reflecting '79.5' instead of '82.0'.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database commands via the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows browser interactions (clicks, typing in forms) rather than terminal windows running 'python manage.py' or SQL commands.

integrity.description: The agent edited the existing entry rather than creating a new one to achieve the target value.
integrity.visual_evidence: The number of entries in the Waist category remains the same; the agent is seen clicking 'Edit' on an existing row rather than 'Add' at the top of the page.

integrity.description: The agent did not modify other measurement categories or other entries in the Waist history.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show only the 'Waist' category being accessed and only the most recent entry being edited.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target category is 'Waist'. The initial value of the most recent entry is exactly 82.0. The required final value is 79.5. A tolerance of 0.05 is acceptable (e.g., 79.50 is valid). The agent must modify the existing record, not create a new one.
